problems.title: The Moon.
problems.statement:
You have 3 minutes to read the problem.
Then accelerated animation of the Moon's motion will be shown twice during 4 minutes.
Moreover at the 2nd time the animation will be paused at the beginning and at the end.
After that you will have 2 minutes to write an answer.
Find out the month of the observation.

problems.title: Motion of the planets.
problems.statement:
You have 2.5 minutes to read the problem.
Then an accelerated animation of the Sun's and planets's motion relative to stars will be shown twice during 5 minutes. Moreover at the 2nd time the animation will be paused at the beginning and at the end.
After that you will have 2 minutes to write the answers.

parts.statement: Estimate dates (+/- 1 week) of the beginning and of the end of the animation.
Write, which constellations (their standard three-letter designation) the Mars and the Venus had passed.
